BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycle profiling; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.101 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The criminal justice training commission shall ensure thatissues related to motorcycle profiling are addressed in basic lawenforcement training and offered to inservice law enforcement officersin conjunction with existing training regarding profiling. (2) Local law enforcement agencies shall add a statement condemningmotorcycle profiling to existing policies regarding profiling. (3) For the purposes of this section, "motorcycle profiling" meansthe illegal use of the fact that a person rides a motorcycle or wearsmotorcyclerelated paraphernalia as a factor in deciding to stop andquestion, take enforcement action, arrest, or search a person orvehicle with or without a legal basis under the United StatesConstitution or Washington state Constitution.
